rich_description: Home Caregiving Grant is a monthly cash payout that helps families defray the cost of caring at home for a Singaporean or PR who needs permanent help with at least three activities of daily living (ADLs) such as bathing, dressing, feeding, transferring, toileting, or moving around. Common situations: long-term recovery from a stroke, advanced dementia, severe disability, or end-stage frailty. The grant is paid to the caregiver's bank account, and the amount is tiered by household monthly per capita income — lower income gets the higher tier. It is deliberately flexible: families can use it to pay for a domestic helper, transport to medical appointments, adult diapers, mobility aids, or just to ease the financial pressure of someone in the household giving up paid work to provide the care. Apply online via the AIC website using the caregiver's SingPass, or have the hospital Medical Social Worker submit during discharge planning.

other_criteria: Care recipient is a Singapore citizen or PR
Care recipient needs permanent help with at least 3 Activities of Daily Living (ADLs)
Cared for at home, not in residential care
Functional assessment certifies the ADL needs
Household monthly per capita income below the HCG ceiling (higher tier for lower income)

required_documents.name: NRIC
required_documents.notes: For both care recipient and caregiver

required_documents.name: Functional Assessment Report
required_documents.notes: Issued by a doctor, AIC-appointed assessor, or hospital MSW; confirms ≥3 ADLs needing help

required_documents.name: Proof of household income
required_documents.notes: Payslips, CPF contribution history, or income tax statements for all working household members

oth_location: Online application via aic.sg using SingPass. Hospital MSWs and Senior Care Centres can assist with the application. PLACEHOLDER — verify if any AIC counter at Tampines OTH handles HCG in person; default routing is online + hospital MSW.
typical_processing_time: Functional assessment + paperwork review approximately 4-6 weeks from submission. Payouts start the month after approval and are typically backdated to the application month.
